DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 読み手のお手伝いをされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be helping with the reading?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この紙芝居を読みたいです。絵を自分へ向けて持ったら、子どもたちには裏が見えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紙芝居絵を自身へ向け聞き手に裏が見えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to read this picture-card story. When I held the pictures facing me, the children could only see the backs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you held the story pictures facing yourself and the listeners saw the backs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 絵の面を聞く方へ向けます。読み手の方には、文章がある面を向けてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Face the pictures toward the listeners. Try facing the side with the text toward yourself as the reader.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 裏の文章が自分に見えました。前の子どもにも、絵が見えるか聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 裏文章が自身側になり子供へ絵の見え方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see the text on the back now. I will ask the children in front whether they can see the pictures, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the text on the back now faces you, and check with the children how well they can see the pictures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 絵が見えるそうです。最初の一文を、そこから読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: They say they can see the picture. Can you read the first sentence from there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 読めます。「小さな鳥が森へ行きました」です。絵をこちらへ返さず、この向きのまま続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最初の文を実際読み絵を戻さず続けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. It says, 'A little bird went to the forest.' I will continue with it facing this way, without turning the picture back toward me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Actually read the first sentence and say you will continue without turning the picture back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の一枚へ移る時は、今の一枚を後ろへ送ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you move to the next card, move the current card to the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後ろへ移しました。次の文章も見えます。順番の番号を見ながら、二枚目を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一枚を後ろへ送り二枚目の文章番号を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I moved it to the back. I can see the next text, too. I will read the second card while checking the numbers showing the order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you moved one card to the back and are checking the text and number on the second card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は持ち方の練習までにして、皆さんへ読む時刻は係と相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us stop at practicing how to hold them today and discuss the time for reading to everyone with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二枚を試せました。最初の番号を前へ戻し、全部そろえて係へお返しします。読む時間を決めてから参加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚試用後先頭番号を戻して返却し読み時刻相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I was able to try two cards. I will put the first number back in front, gather all the cards and return them to the person in charge. I will join in after we decide the reading time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After trying two cards, return the first numbered card to the front and return the set, and ask to discuss the reading time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらでお預かりします。読み聞かせでお会いするのを楽しみにしております。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will keep these here. I look forward to seeing you at the reading session. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発車案内の文字をお読みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you reading the departure display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。行き先を読んでいる途中で画面が変わりました。午後二時台の行を、次に出た時に教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切替で未読の午後二時台の行を次表示時に示してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The screen changed while I was still reading the destination. Could you show me the row for departures in the two o'clock hour this afternoon when it appears next?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to point out the afternoon two o'clock row the next time it appears, since the display changed before you finished reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 次の表示を一緒に待ちましょう。午後二時十分の列車は、三行目です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us wait for the next display together. The 2:10 p.m. train is on the third row.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三行目ですね。今、時刻は読めましたが、行き先の右側はまだ文字が動いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三行目の時刻を読み行先文字が動いていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The third row, then. I can read the time now, but the text to the right showing the destination is still moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have read the time on the third row and the destination text is moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 文字が全部出ました。「桜川」と表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: All the text has appeared now. It says 'Sakuragawa.'

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 桜川ですね。友人へ時刻と行き先を送るため、この一行を写真に撮りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 桜川と理解し友人連絡用に一行撮影を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sakuragawa, then. I would like to photograph this row so I can send my friend the time and destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm Sakuragawa and say you would like to photograph the row to inform your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示が止まっている今でしたら、一行を写せます。こちら側から全体が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can capture the row now while the display is still. You can see the whole thing from this side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写せました。写真では二時十分と桜川の両方が読めます。乗り場もこの行にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時刻行先の可読写真を確認し乗場欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I got the picture. I can read both 2:10 and Sakuragawa in it. Is the platform also on this row?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the time and destination are legible in the photograph and ask about the platform field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一番左の「二」が乗り場です。時刻の二時とは、欄が別になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The '2' at the far left is the platform. It is in a separate field from the two o'clock part of the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二番乗り場ですね。写真の左端も入りました。友人には二時十分、桜川行き、二番乗り場と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二番乗場と二時十分桜川を揃え友人へ連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Platform 2, then. The left edge is in the photograph, too. I will tell my friend 2:10, bound for Sakuragawa, platform 2.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your friend all three details: platform 2, 2:10 and Sakuragawa. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、案内をお役立てください。お連れの方とよいお出かけになりますように。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please make use of the information. I hope you and your companion have a lovely outing. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洋裁教室の持ち物について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about what to bring to the sewing class?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 使いたい布を先生に見てもらいます。全部持つと大きいので、小さく切った見本でもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きな布全体の代わりに小見本持参可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will have the teacher look at the fabric I want to use. The whole piece is bulky to carry, so would a small cut sample be all right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may bring a small sample instead of the entire large piece of fabric. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見本は十センチ四方をご用意ください。布の端から取れる部分で結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please prepare a sample ten centimeters square. A piece you can take from the edge of the fabric is fine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十センチ四方ですね。表と裏の手触りが違う布なので、両方を見せられるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十センチ角を確認し表裏両方を示したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ten centimeters square, then. The front and back of this fabric feel different, so I would like to be able to show both sides.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm a ten-centimeter square and say you want to show both the front and back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紙へ全面を貼らず、端だけ留めると裏もめくれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you fasten just the edge instead of gluing the whole piece to paper, you can turn it over to show the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 端だけ留めます。布の表に名前を書くと見本が変わるので、名前は紙へ書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 端留めで裏を見せ名前は布でなく紙に書く許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will fasten just the edge. Writing my name on the front of the fabric would alter the sample, so may I write my name on the paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask permission to fasten only the edge to show the back and write your name on the paper rather than the fabric. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名前と、作りたい物を紙へお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write your name and what you want to make on the paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の名前と「巾着袋」と書きます。まだ袋の形には切っていないので、相談してから本体を裁ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前と巾着袋目的を記し本体裁断前に相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write my name and 'drawstring bag.' I have not cut it into a bag shape yet, so I would like to consult the teacher before cutting the main piece.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will write your name and your intention to make a drawstring bag and consult the teacher before cutting the main piece. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見本とは別に、布全体の写真もあると柄の大きさを示せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: A photograph of the whole fabric, in addition to the sample, would help show the size of the pattern.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真も準備します。十センチの見本と、柄全体の写真を持ち、巾着袋に使えるか先生へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小見本と全体柄写真を準備し講師へ相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will prepare a photograph, too. I will bring the ten-centimeter sample and a photograph of the entire pattern and ask the teacher whether I can use it for a drawstring bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare the small sample and photograph of the overall pattern and consult the instructor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご準備ください。教室でのご相談にお役立てください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please get those ready, then. I hope they help with your consultation in class. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 着替えのお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help changing clothes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袖を脱ぐ途中で、腕のバンドに布が引っかかりました。バンドを引っ張らずに止めたので、袖を外してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袖が腕バンドへ引っかかり停止した状況を話し看護師介助を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: While I was taking my arm out of the sleeve, the fabric caught on my wristband. I stopped without pulling on the band, so could you free the sleeve for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the sleeve caught on the band on your arm and you stopped, and ask the nurse for help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 腕はそのままで結構です。袖の布を少し戻して、引っかかった所を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can keep your arm where it is. I will ease the sleeve fabric back a little and look at where it is caught.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。腕を回すと布が張るので、今の向きで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 腕の向きを保ち布の張りを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. Turning my arm pulls the fabric tight, so I will wait with it facing this way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the tension in the fabric and keep your arm in its current position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 布がバンドの端に掛かっています。こちらで布を緩めますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The fabric is caught on the edge of the band. I will loosen the fabric here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。バンドの文字が袖に隠れていたので、袖が外れたら見えるかも確認していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袖が外れた後にバンドの文字の見え方を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. The sleeve was hiding the writing on the band, so once the sleeve is free, could you also check whether the writing is visible?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to check whether the writing on the band is visible after freeing the sleeve. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: バンドを付けたまま、袖を外せました。文字も見えます。新しい服の袖もゆっくり通しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I freed the sleeve with the band still on. The writing is visible, too. Let us put the sleeve of the new garment on slowly as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外れました。次はこの袖口を広げてから通したいです。手を出す位置を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袖が外れ次の袖口を広げる手の出口案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is free now. Next, I would like to widen this cuff before putting my hand through. Please show me where to bring my hand out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the sleeve is free and ask where to bring your hand out after widening the next cuff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの開いている所へどうぞ。バンドの周りはこちらで見ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Through this opening here, please. I am watching the area around the band.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手を出せました。バンドもそのままです。脱いだ服はかばんへ入れ、着替えを終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手が通りバンド保持を確認し脱衣収納と着替え終了を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My hand is through. The band is still in place, too. I will put the clothes I took off into my bag and finish changing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your hand is through and the band remains in place, and say you will put away the removed clothes and finish changing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、服をお手元へお戻しします。ほかにお困りでしたらお呼びください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will return your clothes to you, then. Please call if you need any other help. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記入の途中でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble filling something out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お借りしたペンからインクが漏れて、指と机に付きました。用紙にはまだ書いていません。拭く物をいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借用ペン漏れで指机が汚れ用紙未記入と伝え拭紙を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ink leaked from the pen I borrowed and got on my fingers and the desk. I have not written on the form yet. Could I have something to wipe it with?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the borrowed pen leaked onto your fingers and desk and the form is still blank, and ask for paper to wipe with. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの紙で、まず指を拭いてください。漏れたペンはこの受け皿へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wipe your fingers first with this paper. Put the leaking pen in this tray, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ペンを置きました。指のインクを拭けましたが、手を洗ってから新しいペンを使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 故障ペンを皿へ置き指を拭いた後手洗いを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put the pen down. I have wiped the ink off my fingers, but I would like to wash my hands before using a new pen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you put the faulty pen in the tray and wiped your fingers, and would now like to wash your hands. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手洗いはこちらです。机の汚れはこちらで拭き取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The handwashing area is here. I will wipe the ink off the desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。記入用紙は汚れていないので、この乾いた所へ置いてから手を洗いに行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 汚れていない用紙を乾所へ置き洗手すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. The form is not dirty, so I will put it in this dry spot before going to wash my hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will put the clean form in a dry spot and wash your hands. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お戻りですね。机を拭き終えました。こちらの別のペンをご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Welcome back. I have finished wiping the desk. Please use this other pen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け取りました。紙の端で線を引いてみると、インクが普通に出ます。今からこの用紙へ名前を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換ペンの線を試し元の用紙記入を再開する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have it. When I try drawing a line on the edge of the paper, the ink flows normally. I will now write my name on this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Try a line with the replacement pen and resume filling out the original form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご記入が済みましたら、用紙をこちらへお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you have finished filling it out, please submit the form here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と連絡先を書けました。こちらへ出します。最初の漏れたペンは受け皿にありますので、次の方へ渡さず見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名連絡先記入済を提出し漏れペンの確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written my name and contact information. Here it is. The original leaking pen is in the tray, so could you check it instead of giving it to the next person?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the completed name and contact information and ask them to check the leaking pen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらで確認します。お知らせいただきありがとうございました。それでは、相談の担当へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we will check it. Thank you for letting us know. I will now show you to the person handling your consultation. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛名を書く場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to write the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ポスターを入れた筒が机で転がります。包装は済んでいるので、この筒を動かずに置ける台はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装済筒が転がり静置用台を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The tube containing my poster rolls around on the desk. It is already wrapped, so is there a stand that can hold this tube still?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the wrapped tube rolls around and ask for a stand to hold it still. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの二つの支えを使えます。筒の下へ一つずつ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use these two supports. Put them under the tube one at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 置けました。手を離しても止まっています。貼る前の宛名用紙は、隣の平らな所で書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二支えで停止確認し隣平面で宛名記入可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are in place. It stays still even when I let go. May I write on the address label on the flat space next to it before sticking it on?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the two supports keep it still and ask whether you may write the address on the adjacent flat surface. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。書いてから筒へ貼ると、文字を読みやすく整えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. Writing first and then sticking it on the tube lets you arrange the lettering clearly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宛先と自分の住所を書きました。筒を回す時だけ片方の支えを少し離してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 両住所を記し回転時に支えを離す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written the destination and my own address. May I move one support away a little just while I turn the tube?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have written both addresses and ask about moving a support away while turning the tube. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 筒を手で支えて位置を変え、支えを戻してから貼ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Support the tube with your hand as you change its position, then put the support back before attaching the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 位置を変えました。支えも戻ったので、宛名を見える上側へ貼ります。紙の端まで付けられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 筒を支え回転後支え復元し上面に宛名を貼る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I changed its position. The support is back in place, so I will attach the address label on the visible upper side. I have stuck it down all the way to the paper's edges.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Support and turn the tube, restore the support and attach the address label to the top. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 筒を持ち上げる前に、支えが一緒に付いていないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before lifting the tube, please check that the supports are not stuck to it as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛名だけが筒に付いています。二つの支えは台に残しました。筒を両手で持って窓口へ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支え二つを台へ残し筒だけ両手で窓口へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only the address label is attached to the tube. I left the two supports on the worktop. I will carry the tube with both hands and take it to the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave both supports on the worktop and take only the tube to the counter with both hands. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お荷物を確認いたします。作業台をご利用いただきありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check your parcel, then. Thank you for using the worktable. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入口のお荷物について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss the bag by the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 硬貨を持って来ましたが、袋が重くて、ここまで持ち上げられません。入口の椅子の下に置いています。運ぶ手助けをお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入口に置いた重い硬貨袋の運搬介助を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought coins, but the bag is heavy and I cannot lift it up here. I left it under the chair at the entrance. Could you help me carry it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help transporting the heavy bag of coins you left by the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当が台車を持って伺います。ご自身の袋を、入口で示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: A staff member will come with a trolley. Please point out your bag at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 黒い袋です。口は結んだままにしています。硬貨を床へ出さず、袋ごと台車へ載せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 黒い封口袋を示し床へ中身を出さず台車搭載を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the black bag. I have kept the opening tied shut. I would like to put the whole bag on the trolley without emptying the coins onto the floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the tied black bag and say you want it placed on the trolley without emptying its contents onto the floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの袋ですね。担当と一緒に台車へ載せます。持ち手は切れていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This bag here, then. I will put it on the trolley together with the staff member. Are the handles torn?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち手は付いていますが、長く持つと手に食い込みます。台車の上では持ち手を横へ広げて置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち手の食込を説明し台車上の持手配置を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The handles are attached, but they dig into my hands if I hold them for long. I will spread the handles out to the sides on the trolley.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the handles dig into your hands and describe how you will place them on the trolley. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 載せられました。計数の担当の席まで一緒に参りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is on now. Let us go together to the coin-counting staff member's desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。袋は私の目の前に置いて、計数の準備ができてから口を開けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当席へ同行し準備後に目前袋を開けたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I would like the bag kept right in front of me and to open it after everything is ready for counting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will accompany them to the desk and want to open the bag in front of you once preparations are complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当の準備ができました。こちらの台の上で、袋の口をほどいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member is ready now. Please untie the bag opening on this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ほどけました。ここで計数をお願いします。入口から袋を運ぶのを手伝っていただき、助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 台上で封口をほどき計数依頼と介助謝意を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is untied. Please count the coins here. Your help carrying the bag from the entrance was a great help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Untie the opening on the counter, ask for the coins to be counted and express thanks for the help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当が中身を確認します。袋の持ち主としてこちらでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member will now check the contents. Please wait here as the owner of the bag. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the storage bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この見本はファスナーが途中で止まります。大きく開く袋がほしいので、動かし方を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中停止の見本ファスナーの開き方実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The zipper on this sample stops halfway. I want a bag that opens wide, so could you show me how it works?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a demonstration of opening the sample zipper that stops halfway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 布が少し挟まっています。こちらで戻してから、端まで開きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: A little fabric is caught in it. I will move it back first and then open it all the way to the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 端まで開きましたね。厚いタオルを入れたいので、口の両側を広げた形も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 端までの開口確認し厚タオル用に両側展開を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It opened all the way, then. I want to put thick towels inside, so I would also like to see it with both sides of the opening spread out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm it opens to the end and ask to see both sides spread out for thick towels. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このように両側を広げられます。閉める動きも試しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can spread both sides like this. Would you like to try closing it, too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私は片側を持ちますので、店員さんにファスナーを動かしてもらってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 片側を保持して店員に閉める実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I will hold one side, so could you, as the shop assistant, move the zipper for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold one side and ask the shop assistant to demonstrate closing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、閉めます。布を挟まず、最後まで動きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will close it now. It moved all the way without catching the fabric.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 動きが分かりました。家では布がファスナーに挟まらない位置へ寄せてから閉めます。この大きさの新しい物を一枚ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 全開閉を理解し布が挟まらない位置へ寄せて使用すると話し新品一枚を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand how it works. At home, I will move the fabric to a position where it cannot catch in the zipper before closing it. Please give me one new bag in this size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you understand how it opens and closes fully and will move the fabric where it cannot get caught, and choose one new bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未使用の物はこちらです。見本は売り場へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is an unused one. I will put the sample back on display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい物を受け取りました。試した見本と同じ大きさですね。こちらで会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新品と見本同サイズを確認し会計依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the new one. It is the same size as the sample I tried, isn't it? I would like to pay here, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the new one and sample are the same size and ask to pay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、一枚でお会計いたします。お選びいただきありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will ring up one bag, then. Thank you for choosing it. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらで盤のゲームをされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be playing a board game here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人とチェスをしたいのですが、この台は傾いて駒が滑ります。平らな台はほかにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傾斜台でチェス駒が滑り平坦台を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to play chess with a friend, but this table slopes and the pieces slide. Is there another level table?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the chess pieces slide on the sloping table and ask for a level one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 屋根の下の台をご覧ください。台自体は動かさず、盤を置いて確かめられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please look at the table under the roof. You can put the board on it to check without moving the table itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 盤を持って行きます。途中の状態は写真に撮り、駒は箱へ戻してから運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 途中配置を撮影し駒箱と盤を分けて移動すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will take the board over. I will photograph the game in progress and put the pieces back in the box before carrying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will photograph the current position and move the boxed pieces and board separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: あちらへ盤を置けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Were you able to put the board on that table?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 置けました。駒を一つ置いても滑りません。写真を見ながら、さっきの並びに戻したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新台で滑らないと確認し写真通り配置復元を望む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Even when I put a piece on it, it does not slide. I would like to restore the previous position using the photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the pieces do not slide on the new table and say you want to restore the position shown in the photograph. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お二人とも、その台の席に座れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can both of you sit at that table?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人で向かい合って座れます。通路側へ椅子を足さず、備え付けの二席を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 備付二席で向合い通路へ椅子追加不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We can sit facing each other. We will use the two seats already there without adding a chair on the walkway side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you can face each other in the two existing seats and do not need to add a chair in the walkway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 道具はどこへ置かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Where will you put your equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駒の箱はかばんへしまいました。写真どおりに並べ直せたので、友人を呼んで続きから遊びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱収納と写真通り復元完了を報告し同行者と続行する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put the piece box away in my bag. I have restored the position in the photograph, so I will call my friend over and resume the game.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you have put the box away and restored the photographed position, and will continue with your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お二人でお楽しみください。お帰りの際は駒をお忘れなく。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22225-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy your game together, then. Please remember your pieces when you leave. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗る停留所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the stop where you can board?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この地図の花園前から、海の方へ行きたいです。時刻があるので、そこで待てばよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 花園前の時刻記載から乗れると思い利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go toward the sea from Hanazono-mae on this map. There is a time listed, so I thought I could wait there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought you could board at Hanazono-mae because a time was listed and ask about using it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 花園前のこの便は「降車のみ」です。この便には、ここからはご乗車いただけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This service at Hanazono-mae is 'drop-off only.' You cannot board this service here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この便は、ここでは降りるだけなのですね。乗るために使える所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: この便は花園前で降車のみと理解して乗車可の停留所案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So this service only lets passengers get off here. Please show me a place where I can board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that this service is drop-off only at Hanazono-mae and ask directions to a stop where boarding is allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ便には、こちらの中央広場から乗れます。この地図では案内所から歩いて五分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can board the same service at Central Square here. On this map, it is a five-minute walk from the information center.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五分なら歩けます。花園前へ行きかけていましたが、今は案内所にいるので、中央広場へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 架空中央広場徒歩五分を確認し行先停留所を変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can walk five minutes. I was about to go to Hanazono-mae, but I am at the information center now, so I will head to Central Square.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the fictional Central Square is a five-minute walk away and change the stop you are heading to. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中央広場の表示で、行き先もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the destination on the Central Square display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 海辺公園とありますね。行き先はそのままで、乗る場所だけ変わりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 海辺公園行を保ち乗る場所のみ変更と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It says Seaside Park. The destination stays the same; only the boarding location has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you are still going to Seaside Park and only the boarding location has changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発車の表示は、中央広場の欄をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: For the departure time, please look in the Central Square column.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午前十時二十分ですね。友人へ中央広場で乗ると知らせ、地図の花園前の印を中央広場へ直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十時二十分を確認し友人へ連絡して地図印を直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: 10:20 a.m., then. I will tell my friend I am boarding at Central Square and change the Hanazono-mae mark on my map to Central Square.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm 10:20, inform your friend and correct the mark on your map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの地図をお持ちください。バスでのお出かけをお楽しみください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this map with you, then. Enjoy your bus outing. Take care.
